dialogues.speaker: Cat's Tail Message Board
dialogues.text: If you have anything to share, be it brooding or joyous, distressing or hilarious, write them down on our Message Board! Cat's Tail is all cat ears!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Because of my efforts, I have been chosen by the Sage of Sumeru. I leave Mondstadt first thing tomorrow morning to begin my training with the Sage."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "It's a long journey ahead. I've never left Mondstadt in my life, so I'm frightened and excited at the same time. I wonder what Liyue and Sumeru are like."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The training will take years. I've never left my parents... By the time I get back, they will have grown old. This is what pains me the most."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "That said, I am eager to finally begin my journey as a full-grown man. I feel guilty for feeling like this though."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Best wishes and good health to my parents and everybody here at Mondstadt."

dialogues.speaker: Cat's Tail's reply
dialogues.text: No need to feel guilty. It's just part of growing up. I'm sure your parents are proud of you.

dialogues.speaker: Cat's Tail's reply
dialogues.text: Now that you are a man, you deserve a grown-up's drink! Come, and we'll throw you a farewell party at Cat's Tail!
